page: OVHcloud t2-le-180 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. It features 60 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 6226R processors running at 2.9 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 180 GB of system memory, providing 3.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs, delivering a combined 128 GB of VRAM. Storage is provided by a 500 GB local NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong capabilities in parallel processing and memory performance. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves 311.42 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. Passmark memory testing also registers in the top 25% with a score of 2794.65. The server excels in LLM inference tasks; prompt processing for a 7B model reaches 1277.99 tokens/sec, and text generation for the same model achieves 120.29 tokens/sec, both ranking in the top 10% tier. Standard single-core and multi-core CPU benchmarks, such as Geekbench and stress-ng, align with average performance tiers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t2-le-180 offers a dense allocation of four enterprise-grade GPUs alongside 60 dedicated physical cores, making it a highly resource-dense option for parallelized workloads without the overhead of virtualization-induced thread sharing. This hardware profile is well-suited for machine learning training, large-scale LLM inference, high-performance computing, and parallel data processing tasks.

The server's primary strength lies in its graphics hardware, which consists of four NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs providing a total of 128 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration is highly efficient for parallel computing, machine learning, and deep learning workloads.
